description: This script sets up and tests Git repository scenarios involving commit-graphs and partial clones using shell scripting with Git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified Git repository.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Asserts the number of lines in a file equals the specified count.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
